name: Okyu Nanami
source:
"I have been cursed since the day I was born. I do not believe in blessings or luck, only misfortune…"

Reigns from the Heavens, cursed with black wings.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/sinxholic/status/1649759039520210945]Twitter[/url]]
